history.summary: A 1,227sf 3BR in a genuinely strong OCR asset — 78m to Kovan NE13 with a sheltered walkway, 778 units, 50+ deals a year, and one of the deepest exit records in the book (98.5% of 688 resales sold at a profit). The problem is the price, not the property: $2.38M / $1,940psf sits at the very top of what this exact layout has ever printed, above both of its 2026 prints ($2.32M in July, $2.20M in June), with the floor undisclosed and 2.6% gross yield to wait on.
history.rating_rationale: Good development, wrong price. Only two prints in this project's entire history have cleared $1,940psf (Apr-26 $1,954 on floors 11-15; May-26 $1,940 on 16-20), and the market did not hold there — the two most recent prints of this identical 1,227sf layout came in BELOW the ask at $1,891psf ($2.32M, 20 Jul 2026) and $1,793psf ($2.20M, 19 Jun 2026). The ask is +2.6% over the last comparable print, +8.2% over the one before it, and +10.4% over the project's URA median (ask_above_own_stack_prints fires on n=23 same-size comps). PropertyGuru serves no floor for this unit, and $1,940psf implicitly prices a high floor: 24mo same-size prints run $1,600-1,804 on floors 01-05 and $1,611-1,834 on 06-10 versus $1,685-1,954 on 11-15 — if this is a low-floor unit the ask is 12-18% over its true comp, and that is unverifiable in an unattended run. Carry is thin (2.6% gross / 1.6% net; realsmart's own estimate 2.8%), and a 2006 fit-out plausibly needs $40-80k of renovation on top of the ask. Against that, this is emphatically not a value trap: 675 profitable vs 13 unprofitable resales, REALSCORE 4.2, 6.5yr average hold, and same-size-band psf ($1,191 2021 -> $1,806 2025) confirms the appreciation is real rather than a unit-mix artifact. The +31.9% premium to the age-adjusted D19 median is mostly the Kovan-vs-Punggol/Sengkang split within one district — a permanent location level, not overpayment — so it is discounted here; the +10% premium to the project's OWN prints is not. Three competing asks on the same layout ($2.38M / $2.389M / $2.40M) plus two more at $2.49-2.50M means the seller stack is collectively 5-8% above the clearing level and the buyer holds the leverage. Workable at $2.25-2.30M with the floor confirmed; at $2.38M you are paying the top of the range for the story after it has been published.

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Weak but honest. URA project-bed rents put a 1,227sf 3BR at ~$5,200/mo (67 contracts, confidence 0.95); realsmart's latest 12 contracts median $5,050 with 3BRs at $4,900-5,300 and 54 rentals in the past month. On $2.38M that is 2.6% gross / 1.6% net — realsmart's own estimate is 2.8%. Rental demand is deep and reliable (NEL adjacency, mature amenities), but the carry does not pay you to wait, and a 75% LTV buyer is meaningfully cash-flow negative at this price.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: The trailing record is real but should not be extrapolated. The 1,150-1,350sf band went $1,191psf (2021) -> $1,321 (2022) -> $1,437 (2023) -> $1,670 (2024) -> $1,806 (2025), so the 7.39% cache CAGR is not a unit-mix illusion. But the annual project median has decelerated (+4.5% 2025, +3.6% 2026 YTD), 2026's 1,227sf prints are non-monotonic ($2.398M Apr, $2.20M Jun, $2.32M Jul), the project has already been publicly identified as a 2025 top performer, and backtested priors give trailing CAGR ~0 forward power. Forward is modeled at ~4.0%/yr — the OCR realized-forward baseline (+3.7%) with a small credit for MRT-adjacency and buyer-pool depth, not the 7.4% trailing number.
agent_evaluation.stack_notes: No researched profile for Kovan Melody (stack_profile: not_researched) and PropertyGuru serves no floor_level or facing for this listing, so stack/floor cannot be pinned. The 24mo URA prints in the 1,150-1,350sf band segment clearly by floor — 01-05: $1,600-1,804; 06-10: $1,611-1,834; 11-15: $1,685-1,954; 16-20: $1,626-1,940 — so floor is worth roughly $150-250psf here (~$200-300k on this quantum). That is the single largest unknown in the file: confirm the floor before any offer, and run /research-development on Kovan Melody if this project stays on the shortlist.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: OCR realized-forward baseline (+3.7%/yr, full-panel backtest) with a modest uplift for 78m MRT adjacency and very deep buyer pool. The 7.39% ura_5yr_cagr is trailing, in-regime and already partly realized in the 2021-26 re-rating; trailing CAGR is backtested at ~0 forward power so it is deliberately not carried into the ROI.
agent_evaluation.realsmart_note: realsmart.sg /p/kovan-melody, page title confirmed 'Kovan Melody Condo: Price, PSF & Rent' (D19, Hougang, 99yr from 20/01/2004, completed 2006, 778 units) — correct development. REALSCORE 4.2/5; 98.5% profitable on 688 resale pairs (675 profitable / 13 unprofitable) out of 1,427 total transactions since 2004 — far above the 150-resale trust threshold, so this is real downside evidence, not noise. Avg annualized profit 6.5% is the PAST 1 YEAR only and is backward-looking; avg holding 6.5yrs; est. rental yield 2.8%. Data through 20 July 2026.
